scope: POST /videos/:id/upload/completion, response DTO, external-spec HTTP tests and compiled OpenAPI only

implementation.handler: Inherited JWT, CurrentUser.sub, ParseUUIDPipe, body absence validation including unparsed content, existing completion service delegation. Res passthrough preserves serialization and filters while mapping processing to202 and ready to200.
implementation.output: Explicit VideoUploadCompletionDto wraps safe existing VideoStatusDto; no storage keys or upload IDs exposed.
implementation.security: Owner-only completion; foreign/absent/no-channel404; missing/invalidJWT401; UUID/body400; incomplete/mismatched/in-progress409; expired410; real throttle120/min then429; typed storage unavailable503.
implementation.idempotency: Processing replay202 and ready replay200 preserve full video/outbox snapshots, identity and one processing intention. Ready fixture uses real MP4/JPEG objects and already-completed outbox, without pretending worker processing.
implementation.storage: Normal paths upload real bytes through returned signed MinIO permissions; HeadObject and GetObject prove exact original. Missing-part session remains resumable. Actual mismatched stored bytes injected using authenticated S3 UploadPart are rejected and aborted with no processing intention.
implementation.redis_outage: All17 focused tests passed with test Redis deliberately stopped, PostgreSQL/MinIO active, no worker/reconciler. Redis restored before full suites. Outbox persisted exactly once despite offline queue.
implementation.openapi: Both200/202, UUID/JWT, no requestBody, shared errors400/401/404/409/410/413/429/503; committed operations and prior uncommitted SI03.5.5 parts operation preserved.
